from typing import List

class Fenwick:
    def __init__(self, n):
        self.n = n
        self.tree = [0] * (n + 1)
        self.top = 1
        while self.top * 2 <= n:
            self.top *= 2

    def add(self, i, v):
        i += 1
        while i <= self.n:
            self.tree[i] += v
            i += i & (-i)

    def prefix(self, i):
        # sum over [0..i], 0-based; prefix(-1) = 0
        s = 0
        i += 1
        while i > 0:
            s += self.tree[i]
            i -= i & (-i)
        return s

    def kth(self, k):
        # returns 0-based index of k-th (1-based k) element
        pos = 0
        bit = self.top
        while bit:
            if pos + bit <= self.n and self.tree[pos + bit] < k:
                pos += bit
                k -= self.tree[pos]
            bit >>= 1
        return pos


class Solution:
    def numberOfAlternatingGroups(self, colors: List[int], queries: List[List[int]]) -> List[int]:
        n = len(colors)
        colors = colors[:]
        zf = Fenwick(n)       # zero positions in diff
        cntF = Fenwick(n + 1)  # run length -> count
        sumF = Fenwick(n + 1)  # run length -> sum of lengths
        state = {'m': 0}
        diff = [0] * n
        for j in range(n):
            diff[j] = 1 if colors[j] != colors[(j + 1) % n] else 0

        def g(a, b):
            return (b - a - 1) % n

        def add_run(L, sign):
            if L <= 0:
                return
            cntF.add(L, sign)
            sumF.add(L, sign * L)

        def pred(x):
            m = state['m']
            c = zf.prefix(x - 1) if x > 0 else 0
            if c > 0:
                return zf.kth(c)
            return zf.kth(m)

        def succ(x):
            m = state['m']
            c = zf.prefix(x)
            if c < m:
                return zf.kth(c + 1)
            return zf.kth(1)

        # Initial build
        zeros = [j for j in range(n) if diff[j] == 0]
        for z in zeros:
            zf.add(z, 1)
        state['m'] = len(zeros)
        m = len(zeros)
        if m > 0:
            for idx in range(m):
                a = zeros[idx]
                b = zeros[(idx + 1) % m]
                add_run(g(a, b), 1)

        def set_zero(x, present):
            # present=True: diff[x] becomes 0; False: becomes 1
            m = state['m']
            if present:
                if m == 0:
                    add_run(n - 1, 1)
                else:
                    a = pred(x)
                    b = succ(x)
                    add_run(g(a, b), -1)
                    add_run(g(a, x), 1)
                    add_run(g(x, b), 1)
                zf.add(x, 1)
                state['m'] = m + 1
            else:
                zf.add(x, -1)
                state['m'] = m - 1
                m = state['m']
                if m == 0:
                    add_run(n - 1, -1)
                else:
                    a = pred(x)
                    b = succ(x)
                    add_run(g(a, x), -1)
                    add_run(g(x, b), -1)
                    add_run(g(a, b), 1)

        result = []
        for q in queries:
            if q[0] == 1:
                k = q[1]
                if state['m'] == 0:
                    result.append(n)
                else:
                    t = k - 1
                    total_c = cntF.prefix(n)
                    total_s = sumF.prefix(n)
                    c = total_c - cntF.prefix(t - 1)
                    s = total_s - sumF.prefix(t - 1)
                    result.append(s - (t - 1) * c)
            else:
                i, c = q[1], q[2]
                if colors[i] == c:
                    continue
                colors[i] = c
                for j in ((i - 1) % n, i):
                    nd = 1 if colors[j] != colors[(j + 1) % n] else 0
                    if nd != diff[j]:
                        diff[j] = nd
                        set_zero(j, nd == 0)
        return result

class Solution:
    def numberOfAlternatingGroups(self, colors: List[int], queries: List[List[int]]) -> List[int]:
        n = len(colors)
        c = list(colors)
        brk = [c[i] == c[(i + 1) % n] for i in range(n)]
        B = sorted(i for i in range(n) if brk[i])

        fc = [0] * (n + 2)  # Fenwick over run length R (index R+1): counts
        fs = [0] * (n + 2)  # Fenwick over run length R: sums of R
        tot = [0, 0]        # total count, total sum

        def bit_add(tree, i, v):
            while i <= n + 1:
                tree[i] += v
                i += i & (-i)

        def bit_sum(tree, i):
            s = 0
            while i > 0:
                s += tree[i]
                i -= i & (-i)
            return s

        def add_run(R, s):
            bit_add(fc, R + 1, s)
            bit_add(fs, R + 1, s * R)
            tot[0] += s
            tot[1] += s * R

        def gap(a, b):
            return (b - a - 1) % n

        m = len(B)
        if m > 0:
            for j in range(m):
                a = B[j]
                b = B[(j + 1) % m]
                add_run(gap(a, b), 1)

        def toggle(p, becomes_break):
            idx = bisect_left(B, p)
            if becomes_break:
                if not B:
                    add_run(n - 1, 1)
                    B.insert(idx, p)
                    return
                pred = B[idx - 1] if idx > 0 else B[-1]
                succ = B[idx] if idx < len(B) else B[0]
                add_run(gap(pred, succ), -1)
                add_run(gap(pred, p), 1)
                add_run(gap(p, succ), 1)
                B.insert(idx, p)
            else:
                # B[idx] == p
                del B[idx]
                if not B:
                    add_run(n - 1, -1)
                    return
                pred = B[idx - 1] if idx > 0 else B[-1]
                succ = B[idx] if idx < len(B) else B[0]
                add_run(gap(pred, p), -1)
                add_run(gap(p, succ), -1)
                add_run(gap(pred, succ), 1)

        res = []
        for q in queries:
            if q[0] == 1:
                k = q[1]
                if not B:
                    res.append(n)
                    continue
                L = k - 1
                cnt_le = bit_sum(fc, L)
                sum_le = bit_sum(fs, L)
                cnt_ge = tot[0] - cnt_le
                sum_ge = tot[1] - sum_le
                res.append(sum_ge - (k - 2) * cnt_ge)
            else:
                idx, col = q[1], q[2]
                c[idx] = col
                for j in ((idx - 1) % n, idx):
                    nb = c[j] == c[(j + 1) % n]
                    if nb != brk[j]:
                        brk[j] = nb
                        toggle(j, nb)
        return res

class Solution:
    def numberOfAlternatingGroups(self, colors: List[int], queries: List[List[int]]) -> List[int]:
        n = len(colors)
        c = colors[:]
        bad = [c[i] == c[(i + 1) % n] for i in range(n)]
        B = sorted(i for i in range(n) if bad[i])

        fc = [0] * (n + 1)
        fs = [0] * (n + 1)

        def upd(L, dc):
            i = L
            while i <= n:
                fc[i] += dc
                fs[i] += dc * L
                i += i & -i

        def pref(i):
            cnt = 0
            sm = 0
            while i > 0:
                cnt += fc[i]
                sm += fs[i]
                i -= i & -i
            return cnt, sm

        def gap(a, b):
            return (b - a - 1) % n

        def addrun(L, sign):
            if L > 0:
                upd(L, sign)

        m = len(B)
        if m > 0:
            for j in range(m):
                addrun(gap(B[j], B[(j + 1) % m]), 1)

        def insert(e):
            m = len(B)
            if m == 0:
                B.append(e)
                addrun(n - 1, 1)
                return
            j = bisect_left(B, e)
            p = B[j - 1]
            s = B[j % m]
            addrun(gap(p, s), -1)
            addrun(gap(p, e), 1)
            addrun(gap(e, s), 1)
            B.insert(j, e)

        def remove(e):
            j = bisect_left(B, e)
            m = len(B)
            if m == 1:
                addrun(n - 1, -1)
                B.pop()
                return
            p = B[j - 1]
            s = B[(j + 1) % m]
            addrun(gap(p, e), -1)
            addrun(gap(e, s), -1)
            addrun(gap(p, s), 1)
            del B[j]

        ans = []
        for q in queries:
            if q[0] == 1:
                k = q[1]
                if not B:
                    ans.append(n)
                else:
                    pc, ps = pref(k - 2)
                    tc, ts = pref(n)
                    cnt = tc - pc
                    sm = ts - ps
                    ans.append(sm - (k - 2) * cnt)
            else:
                idx, col = q[1], q[2]
                c[idx] = col
                for e in ((idx - 1) % n, idx):
                    nb = c[e] == c[(e + 1) % n]
                    if nb != bad[e]:
                        bad[e] = nb
                        if nb:
                            insert(e)
                        else:
                            remove(e)
        return ans

class Solution:
    def numberOfAlternatingGroups(self, colors: List[int], queries: List[List[int]]) -> List[int]:
        n = len(colors)
        c = colors[:]
        same = [1 if c[e] == c[(e + 1) % n] else 0 for e in range(n)]

        # Fenwick over positions (1-indexed internally)
        pbit = [0] * (n + 1)
        LOG = 1
        while LOG * 2 <= n:
            LOG *= 2

        def pos_upd(p, d):
            i = p + 1
            while i <= n:
                pbit[i] += d
                i += i & (-i)

        def pref(i):  # count of positions in [0, i-1]
            s = 0
            while i > 0:
                s += pbit[i]
                i -= i & (-i)
            return s

        def kth(t):  # 0-based position of t-th (1-based) element
            idx = 0
            step = LOG
            while step:
                nxt = idx + step
                if nxt <= n and pbit[nxt] < t:
                    idx = nxt
                    t -= pbit[nxt]
                step >>= 1
            return idx

        # Fenwick over run lengths L in [0, n-1], stored at index L+1
        cbit = [0] * (n + 1)
        sbit = [0] * (n + 1)
        tot = [0, 0]  # total count, total sum

        def run_upd(L, sign):
            tot[0] += sign
            tot[1] += sign * L
            i = L + 1
            while i <= n:
                cbit[i] += sign
                sbit[i] += sign * L
                i += i & (-i)

        def run_prefix(L):  # count and sum of runs with length <= L
            cc = 0
            ss = 0
            i = L + 1
            while i > 0:
                cc += cbit[i]
                ss += sbit[i]
                i -= i & (-i)
            return cc, ss

        m = 0
        for e in range(n):
            if same[e]:
                pos_upd(e, 1)
                m += 1
        if m == 0:
            pass
        elif m == 1:
            p = [e for e in range(n) if same[e]][0]
            run_upd(n - 1, 1)
        else:
            plist = [e for e in range(n) if same[e]]
            for i in range(m):
                a = plist[i]
                b = plist[(i + 1) % m]
                run_upd((b - a - 1) % n, 1)

        def insert(p):
            nonlocal m
            if m == 0:
                run_upd(n - 1, 1)
                pos_upd(p, 1)
                m = 1
                return
            c_le = pref(p + 1)
            b = kth(c_le + 1) if c_le < m else kth(1)
            a = kth(c_le) if c_le > 0 else kth(m)
            run_upd((b - a - 1) % n, -1)
            run_upd((p - a - 1) % n, 1)
            run_upd((b - p - 1) % n, 1)
            pos_upd(p, 1)
            m += 1

        def remove(p):
            nonlocal m
            pos_upd(p, -1)
            m -= 1
            if m == 0:
                run_upd(n - 1, -1)
                return
            c_lt = pref(p)
            b = kth(c_lt + 1) if c_lt < m else kth(1)
            a = kth(c_lt) if c_lt > 0 else kth(m)
            run_upd((p - a - 1) % n, -1)
            run_upd((b - p - 1) % n, -1)
            run_upd((b - a - 1) % n, 1)

        res = []
        for q in queries:
            if q[0] == 1:
                k = q[1]
                if m == 0:
                    res.append(n)
                else:
                    t = k - 3
                    if t >= 0:
                        pc, ps = run_prefix(t)
                    else:
                        pc, ps = 0, 0
                    sc = tot[0] - pc
                    ss = tot[1] - ps
                    res.append(ss - (k - 2) * sc)
            else:
                idx, col = q[1], q[2]
                c[idx] = col
                for e in ((idx - 1) % n, idx):
                    new = 1 if c[e] == c[(e + 1) % n] else 0
                    if new != same[e]:
                        same[e] = new
                        if new:
                            insert(e)
                        else:
                            remove(e)
        return res

class Solution:
    def numberOfAlternatingGroups(self, colors: List[int], queries: List[List[int]]) -> List[int]:
        n = len(colors)
        colors = list(colors)
        bad = [0] * n
        B = []
        for i in range(n):
            if colors[i] == colors[(i + 1) % n]:
                bad[i] = 1
                B.append(i)

        size = n + 2
        cntT = [0] * (size + 1)
        sumT = [0] * (size + 1)
        totCnt = [0]
        totSum = [0]

        def add(r, dc, ds):
            totCnt[0] += dc
            totSum[0] += ds
            i = r + 1
            while i <= size:
                cntT[i] += dc
                sumT[i] += ds
                i += i & (-i)

        def pref(r):
            # sums over run lengths <= r
            c = 0
            s = 0
            i = r + 1
            while i > 0:
                c += cntT[i]
                s += sumT[i]
                i -= i & (-i)
            return c, s

        def gap(a, b):
            return (b - a - 1) % n

        m = len(B)
        for j in range(m):
            a = B[j]
            b = B[(j + 1) % m]
            g = gap(a, b)
            add(g, 1, g)

        def toggle(e, becomes_bad):
            if becomes_bad:
                if not B:
                    B.append(e)
                    add(n - 1, 1, n - 1)
                    return
                m_ = len(B)
                idx = bisect_left(B, e)
                p = B[idx - 1] if idx > 0 else B[-1]
                s = B[idx] if idx < m_ else B[0]
                g = gap(p, s)
                add(g, -1, -g)
                B.insert(idx, e)
                g1 = gap(p, e)
                add(g1, 1, g1)
                g2 = gap(e, s)
                add(g2, 1, g2)
            else:
                m_ = len(B)
                idx = bisect_left(B, e)
                if m_ == 1:
                    B.pop()
                    add(n - 1, -1, -(n - 1))
                    return
                p = B[idx - 1] if idx > 0 else B[-1]
                s = B[idx + 1] if idx + 1 < m_ else B[0]
                g1 = gap(p, e)
                add(g1, -1, -g1)
                g2 = gap(e, s)
                add(g2, -1, -g2)
                g = gap(p, s)
                add(g, 1, g)
                B.pop(idx)

        res = []
        for q in queries:
            if q[0] == 1:
                k = q[1]
                if not B:
                    res.append(n)
                    continue
                L = k - 1
                pc, ps = pref(L)
                cntGE = totCnt[0] - pc
                sumGE = totSum[0] - ps
                res.append(sumGE - (L - 1) * cntGE)
            else:
                idx, c = q[1], q[2]
                if colors[idx] == c:
                    continue
                colors[idx] = c
                for e in ((idx - 1) % n, idx):
                    nb = 1 if colors[e] == colors[(e + 1) % n] else 0
                    if nb != bad[e]:
                        bad[e] = nb
                        toggle(e, nb == 1)
        return res

class Solution:
    def numberOfAlternatingGroups(self, colors: List[int], queries: List[List[int]]) -> List[int]:
        n = len(colors)
        col = colors[:]
        e = [1 if col[i] != col[(i + 1) % n] else 0 for i in range(n)]
        zeros = [i for i in range(n) if e[i] == 0]

        # Fenwick trees over run lengths L in [0, n-1], stored at index L+1
        bc = [0] * (n + 2)
        bs = [0] * (n + 2)
        tot = [0, 0]  # total count, total sum of lengths

        def bit_add(L, dc, ds):
            i = L + 1
            while i <= n:
                bc[i] += dc
                bs[i] += ds
                i += i & (-i)

        def bit_prefix(x):
            # sums over runs with length <= x
            c = 0
            s = 0
            i = x + 1
            while i > 0:
                c += bc[i]
                s += bs[i]
                i -= i & (-i)
            return c, s

        def add_run(L, sign):
            bit_add(L, sign, sign * L)
            tot[0] += sign
            tot[1] += sign * L

        for j in range(len(zeros)):
            p = zeros[j]
            q = zeros[(j + 1) % len(zeros)]
            add_run((q - p - 1) % n, 1)

        def insert_zero(p):
            m = len(zeros)
            if m == 0:
                zeros.append(p)
                add_run(n - 1, 1)
                return
            idx = bisect.bisect_left(zeros, p)
            a = zeros[idx - 1]
            b = zeros[idx % m]
            add_run((b - a - 1) % n, -1)
            zeros.insert(idx, p)
            add_run((p - a - 1) % n, 1)
            add_run((b - p - 1) % n, 1)

        def remove_zero(p):
            m = len(zeros)
            idx = bisect.bisect_left(zeros, p)
            if m == 1:
                add_run(n - 1, -1)
                zeros.pop(idx)
                return
            a = zeros[idx - 1]
            b = zeros[(idx + 1) % m]
            add_run((p - a - 1) % n, -1)
            add_run((b - p - 1) % n, -1)
            zeros.pop(idx)
            add_run((b - a - 1) % n, 1)

        def set_edge(j, newv):
            if newv == e[j]:
                return
            e[j] = newv
            if newv == 0:
                insert_zero(j)
            else:
                remove_zero(j)

        res = []
        for qu in queries:
            if qu[0] == 1:
                k = qu[1]
                if not zeros:
                    res.append(n)
                    continue
                t = k - 1
                # runs with L >= t
                pc, ps = bit_prefix(t - 1)
                C = tot[0] - pc
                S = tot[1] - ps
                res.append(S - (t - 1) * C)
            else:
                idx, c = qu[1], qu[2]
                if col[idx] == c:
                    continue
                col[idx] = c
                for j in ((idx - 1) % n, idx):
                    nv = 1 if col[j] != col[(j + 1) % n] else 0
                    set_edge(j, nv)
        return res

class Solution:
    def numberOfAlternatingGroups(self, colors: List[int], queries: List[List[int]]) -> List[int]:
        n = len(colors)
        col = list(colors)
        N = n + 2
        fc = [0] * (N + 1)
        fs = [0] * (N + 1)
        total_cnt = [0]
        total_sum = [0]

        def fen_add(L, dc, ds):
            i = L + 1
            while i <= N:
                fc[i] += dc
                fs[i] += ds
                i += i & (-i)

        def add_run(L, s):
            # s = +1 to add a run of length L, -1 to remove it
            total_cnt[0] += s
            total_sum[0] += s * L
            fen_add(L, s, s * L)

        def prefix(t):
            # sums over L in [0, t-1], i.e. Fenwick indices 1..t
            c = 0
            sm = 0
            i = t
            while i > 0:
                c += fc[i]
                sm += fs[i]
                i -= i & (-i)
            return c, sm

        def gap(x, y):
            d = (y - x) % n
            return d if d else n

        isbad = [col[p] == col[(p + 1) % n] for p in range(n)]
        B = [p for p in range(n) if isbad[p]]
        m = len(B)
        if m > 0:
            for j in range(m):
                a = B[j]
                b = B[(j + 1) % m]
                add_run(gap(a, b) - 1, 1)

        def ins(p):
            if not B:
                add_run(n - 1, 1)
                insort(B, p)
                return
            i = bisect_left(B, p)
            a = B[i - 1] if i > 0 else B[-1]
            b = B[i] if i < len(B) else B[0]
            add_run(gap(a, b) - 1, -1)
            add_run(gap(a, p) - 1, 1)
            add_run(gap(p, b) - 1, 1)
            insort(B, p)

        def rem(p):
            i = bisect_left(B, p)
            del B[i]
            if not B:
                add_run(n - 1, -1)
                return
            a = B[i - 1] if i > 0 else B[-1]
            b = B[i] if i < len(B) else B[0]
            add_run(gap(a, p) - 1, -1)
            add_run(gap(p, b) - 1, -1)
            add_run(gap(a, b) - 1, 1)

        res = []
        for q in queries:
            if q[0] == 1:
                k = q[1]
                if not B:
                    res.append(n)
                    continue
                t = k - 1
                pc, ps = prefix(t)
                cnt_ge = total_cnt[0] - pc
                sum_ge = total_sum[0] - ps
                res.append(sum_ge + cnt_ge * (2 - k))
            else:
                idx, c = q[1], q[2]
                col[idx] = c
                for p in ((idx - 1) % n, idx):
                    nb = col[p] == col[(p + 1) % n]
                    if nb != isbad[p]:
                        isbad[p] = nb
                        if nb:
                            ins(p)
                        else:
                            rem(p)
        return res

class Solution:
    def numberOfAlternatingGroups(self, colors: List[int], queries: List[List[int]]) -> List[int]:
        n = len(colors)
        c = colors[:]
        iszero = [c[p] == c[(p + 1) % n] for p in range(n)]
        Z = [p for p in range(n) if iszero[p]]

        bc = [0] * (n + 2)
        bs = [0] * (n + 2)
        state = [0, 0]  # totC, totS

        def upd(L, dc, ds):
            i = L + 1
            while i <= n + 1:
                bc[i] += dc
                bs[i] += ds
                i += i & -i

        def add_run(L, s):
            upd(L, s, s * L)
            state[0] += s
            state[1] += s * L

        def pref(k):
            # sums over run lengths L <= k
            cnt = 0
            sm = 0
            i = k + 1
            while i > 0:
                cnt += bc[i]
                sm += bs[i]
                i -= i & -i
            return cnt, sm

        m0 = len(Z)
        for j in range(m0):
            a = Z[j]
            b = Z[(j + 1) % m0]
            add_run((b - a - 1) % n, 1 if False else 1) if False else None
            L = (b - a - 1) % n
            add_run(L, 1)

        def toggle_insert(p):
            m = len(Z)
            if m == 0:
                Z.append(p)
                add_run(n - 1, 1)
                return
            i = bisect_left(Z, p)
            a = Z[i - 1]
            b = Z[i % m]
            add_run((b - a - 1) % n, -1)
            add_run((p - a - 1) % n, 1)
            add_run((b - p - 1) % n, 1)
            Z.insert(i, p)

        def toggle_remove(p):
            m = len(Z)
            i = bisect_left(Z, p)
            if m == 1:
                add_run(n - 1, -1)
                Z.pop()
                return
            a = Z[i - 1]
            b = Z[(i + 1) % m]
            add_run((p - a - 1) % n, -1)
            add_run((b - p - 1) % n, -1)
            add_run((b - a - 1) % n, 1)
            del Z[i]

        res = []
        for q in queries:
            if q[0] == 1:
                s = q[1]
                if len(Z) == 0:
                    res.append(n)
                    continue
                t = s - 1
                pc, ps = pref(t - 1)
                C = state[0] - pc
                S = state[1] - ps
                res.append(S - (t - 1) * C)
            else:
                idx, col = q[1], q[2]
                c[idx] = col
                for p in {(idx - 1) % n, idx}:
                    newz = c[p] == c[(p + 1) % n]
                    if iszero[p] != newz:
                        iszero[p] = newz
                        if newz:
                            toggle_insert(p)
                        else:
                            toggle_remove(p)
        return res
